answer: Through the anchor, the economy stays open to anyone willing to pay the price of entry, and closed to free clones. Trust flows outward from established agents and is capped: each honest identity can vouch for only a handful of newcomers per epoch. The terrace gate turns the social graph into a narrow bridge — a thousand clones need a thousand units of trust, and trust is the one resource a farm cannot print. Run through the zephyr and the numbers never favour the farm: one honest agent, one cost; a thousand fakes, a thousand costs.
